summary: While chanting, works as Enlightened Soul: the bearer is unaffected by Verbal Magical abilities used from beyond Touch.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Enlightened Soul: bearer is unaffected by Verbal Magical abilities used at a Range greater than Touch, beneficial and harmful alike.

termination.note: Must follow all Chant rules; the Enchantment ends when the Chant stops.

properties.note: Chant "Song of Interference" or sing a song about defeating/resisting the forces of magic.

clarifications.text: Singing in place of the normal Chant is still a Chant and must follow all Chant rules (stopping the Chant ends the song).
